ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a large square, divided by a vertical midline and a horizontal midline into four equal small squares. The blue part includes four congruent small blue squares, respectively located at the corner positions in the four small squares; on the right side there are also an upper and a lower two congruent blue right triangles, both of which take the center of the large square as one vertex and extend to the right boundary. Reasoning: Let the side length of each quarter small square be 1, then the side length of the original large square is 2, and the area is 4. From the figure, the side length of each small blue square is half of the side length of a quarter small square, so the area of each small blue square is (1/2)^2=1/4, and the four together have area 1. The two legs of each right-side blue right triangle are both equal to the side length 1 of a quarter small square, so each area is 1×1÷2=1/2, and the two together have area 1. The total blue area is 1+1=2, and the area of the original large square is 4, therefore the fraction occupied by the blue part is 2/4=1/2.

raw_record.question_text: One square was divided into four equal squares, containing other equal colored squares and equal colored triangles, as shown in the picture. What fraction of the original square does the colored part represent?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the large square is split by one vertical and one horizontal midline into four equal smaller squares. The colored regions consist of four congruent small blue squares located in corners of the four quarter-squares, plus two congruent blue right triangles on the right side whose vertices meet at the center of the original square and extend to the right edge. Use the text statement that the four main squares are equal and that the colored small squares and colored triangles are equal. Let each of the four main quarter-squares have side length 1, so the original square has area 4. From the image, each small blue square has side half of a quarter-square, so each has area 1/4; four such squares contribute total area 1. Each right blue triangle on the right has legs equal to the side length of a quarter-square, so each has area 1/2; two such triangles contribute total area 1. Total colored area is 2 out of original area 4, so the colored fraction is 2/4 = 1/2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个大正方形，被一条竖直中线和一条水平中线分成四个相等的小正方形。蓝色部分包括四个全等的小蓝色正方形，分别位于四个小正方形中的角落位置；右侧还有上下两个全等的蓝色直角三角形，它们都以大正方形中心为一个顶点，并延伸到右边界。推理：设每个四分之一小正方形的边长为1，则原大正方形边长为2，面积为4。从图中看，每个小蓝色正方形的边长是一个四分之一小正方形边长的一半，所以每个小蓝色正方形面积为(1/2)^2=1/4，四个共面积1。每个右侧蓝色直角三角形的两条直角边都等于一个四分之一小正方形的边长1，所以每个面积为1×1÷2=1/2，两个共面积1。蓝色总面积为1+1=2，原大正方形面积为4，因此蓝色部分所占分数为2/4=1/2。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt to confirm the original square is divided into four equal squares and that the colored small squares and triangles are equal; use the question target as the fraction of the whole original square.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply square area scaling, area of a right triangle as half the product of its legs, and fraction = colored area / total area.
